correctness.rationale: The 4-dimensional GKZ affine difference representation consists of Fourier weights 2 and 3. Equivariant polar duality identifies the diagonal complex with S^3 acted on by r(z,w)=(zeta^2 z,zeta^3 w), s(z,w)=(conj z,conj w). Nonidentity rotations fix no points; each reflection fixes S^1 and the stabilizer acts as +1 on its tangent and -1 on a normal real 2-plane. Thus the quotient is a closed 3-manifold. Armstrong gives pi_1=D7/normal-closure(reflections)=1, so the established three-dimensional Poincare theorem yields a homeomorphism to S^3. The supplied deterministic checker separately confirms all 196 nonempty faces, quotient-cell counts (19,91,144,72), boundary squares, modular ranks and seven reflection-fixed 10-cycles. Finite computations are corroborative, not an infinite or independent certification.

value.rationale: The full D7 geometric orbit of the canonical three-dimensional heptagon associahedral sphere is a natural integral homeomorphism invariant. Published C7 identification leaves nontrivial seven-primary pi1; adding reflections could yield a manifold, a boundary, or branched singular topology. This claim resolves the local fixed-circle geometry and precisely classifies the full quotient as S3. It is not an arbitrary numerical slice or homology-only computation: the complete homeomorphism type is determined. The established general theorems are credited.
